tools.name: mota_start_game
tools.description: Starts a new game from the title screen. Supply a listed difficulty when the game requires one.

difficulty.description: Exact difficulty name returned by mota_status; required when the title screen lists difficulty options.

summary.zh: 从标题界面开始新游戏；如有难度选项，必须提供 mota_status 返回的准确难度名称。
summary.en: Starts a new game from the title screen; provide the exact difficulty name returned by mota_status when required.

tools.name: mota_move
tools.description: Moves the hero up to the requested number of tiles in one cardinal direction, stopping at an event, obstruction, floor change, or game lock.

steps.description: Number of tiles to attempt in this direction; defaults to 1 and cannot exceed 16.

summary.zh: 按指定方向连续移动指定格数，遇到事件或阻挡时停止并返回实际移动结果。
summary.en: Moves in one direction for the requested number of tiles and stops at an event or obstruction.

tools.name: mota_move_to
tools.description: Moves the hero to a tile on the current floor with the game click-to-move: it teleports when the game allows it and otherwise walks the route. A door, item, enemy, or stairs tile may be the target; a teleport then lands next to it and steps in to trigger it. Stops at events, obstructions, floor changes, or interruption and reports mode teleport, walk, or none, with teleportUnavailable explaining a walk.

x.description: Destination tile x coordinate on the current floor.

y.description: Destination tile y coordinate on the current floor.

summary.zh: 移动到当前楼层的目标坐标（自动优先瞬移，不可瞬移时寻路步行），可直接指定门、道具、怪物或楼梯坐标，并返回移动方式与实际位置。
summary.en: Moves to a target coordinate on the current floor (teleporting when allowed, otherwise walking the route); accepts door, item, enemy, or stairs coordinates and reports the movement mode and actual position.

tools.name: mota_event_action
tools.description: Advances the current dialogue line or selects one visible event choice.

index.description: Zero-based visible choice index; required for choose.

summary.zh: 推进当前对话一行，或选择一个可见事件选项。
summary.en: Advances one dialogue line or selects one visible event choice.

tools.name: mota_event
tools.description: Reads the active game event, visible dialogue text, and choices. Use mota_event_action to continue dialogue or choose an option.

summary.zh: 读取当前游戏事件、显示的对话文字和选项。
summary.en: Reads the active game event, visible dialogue text, and choices.

tools.name: mota_screenshot
tools.description: Captures the full Magic Tower game area with its actual layout as an image for visual inspection.

summary.zh: 按游戏实际布局截取魔塔完整游戏区域，供视觉检查。
summary.en: Captures the Magic Tower game area with its actual layout for visual inspection.

tools.name: mota_saves
tools.description: Lists occupied manual save slots and whether an autosave is available.

summary.zh: 列出已有的手动存档槽和自动存档状态。
summary.en: Lists occupied manual save slots and autosave availability.

tools.name: mota_save
tools.description: Saves the current game to a numbered slot. Existing saves require explicit overwrite=true.

slot.description: Manual save slot number; autosave slot 0 cannot be overwritten.

overwrite.description: Set true only when the user explicitly asks to replace an existing save.

summary.zh: 将当前游戏保存到指定存档槽，默认不覆盖已有存档。
summary.en: Saves the current game to a slot without overwriting an existing save by default.

tools.name: mota_load
tools.description: Loads a numbered save slot; slot 0 loads the latest autosave.

slot.description: Manual slot 1–5000, or 0 for the latest autosave.

summary.zh: 读取指定存档槽；槽位 0 表示最近的自动存档。
summary.en: Loads a save slot; slot 0 means the latest autosave.

tools.name: mota_status
tools.description: Reads the current game phase and hero status.

summary.zh: 读取魔塔当前阶段与勇者状态。
summary.en: Reads the current game phase and hero status.

tools.name: mota_map
tools.description: Reads the current floor as a character grid with teleport reachability, zero-cost reachable objects (freeReachable), minimum-cost route to the up-stairs (upStairsRoute), item effect values (itemValues), object coordinates, damage tiles, and one row per enemy type with the game-calculated damage and next attack critical.

summary.zh: 读取当前楼层的字符网格、瞬移可达性、零代价可达对象、上楼最短路线代价、道具数值、对象坐标与怪物伤害及临界摘要。
summary.en: Reads the current floor character grid, teleport reachability, zero-cost reachable objects, minimum-cost route to up-stairs, item effect values, object coordinates, and enemy damage and critical summary.

tools.name: mota_battle
tools.description: Reads the full game-calculated combat details for one enemy at a map coordinate. mota_map already lists damage, stats, and critical per enemy type.

summary.zh: 查询指定坐标单个怪物的详细游戏战斗计算结果。
summary.en: Reads the full game-calculated combat details for an enemy at a map coordinate.

tools.name: mota_resources
tools.description: Reads uncollected items, unopened doors, and remaining enemies across all visited floors, reporting both tower totals and per-floor coordinates.

summary.zh: 查询全塔所有已探索楼层中残留的道具、未开的门与剩余怪物，包含总量汇总与每层坐标明细。
summary.en: Reads uncollected items, unopened doors, and remaining enemies across all visited floors, with tower totals and per-floor details.

tools.name: mota_fly
tools.description: Jumps directly to a previously visited floor using the floor jump device (fly item).

summary.zh: 使用楼层跳跃器（fly道具）直接传送到任意已探索过的楼层。
summary.en: Jumps directly to a previously visited floor using the floor jump device (fly item).

description.zh: 主动推塔开启时定时发送当前游戏状态并唤醒 Coo。
description.en: Periodically sends the current game state and wakes Coo when autonomous play is enabled.

description.zh: 操作者暂停了魔塔主动推塔。
description.en: The operator paused autonomous Magic Tower play.

prompts.title: 魔塔 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
经典魔塔已通过本机桥接接入。主动推塔：{{mota.autoplay}}；唤醒间隔：{{mota.autoplay_interval}} 秒；截图：{{mota.screenshot}}。

主动推塔开启后，Mota World 会按设定间隔发送精简状态摘要并唤醒你，无需等待新的聊天消息。每次操作后直接根据工具回执中的 `at`（位置）、`changes`（属性与物品增减）、`event`（触发事件）和 `floor`（换层时自动附带的新楼层视图）继续规划，不要在每次移动后重复调用 `mota_status` 或 `mota_map`。暂停事件只在当前设置为关闭时表示停止；始终以当前开关为准。遇到游戏结束、错误或工具轮次上限时停止；遇到困难、卡关或重大抉择时向主人求助。主动推塔关闭时，只响应用户直接提出的游戏操作请求。

## 推塔技巧、地图理解与回溯策略

- 只有用户明确要求开始新游戏时才调用 `mota_start_game`。开始前先用 `mota_status` 查看 `menu.canStart` 和难度列表；需要难度时，使用列表中的 `name`。若用户没有指定难度，先询问用户。
- **直接读取预计算字段，无需逐格数字符网格**：`mota_map` 与换层回执的 `floor` 已为你算好：
  - `freeReachable`：当前不开门不打怪即可直接瞬移或走过去触达的道具、门、楼梯和 NPC 坐标。
  - `upStairsRoute`：从当前位置通往上楼楼梯 `upFloor` 战损最低的路线，包含是否当前可过（`canPassNow`）、沿途总伤害（`totalDamage`）、需开的门（`doors`）、沿途必打的怪（`enemies`）以及第一步应前往的阻挡物或楼梯坐标（`firstStepTarget`）。
  - `itemValues`：本层各地面道具的真实数值（如 `redGem: "atk+1"`、`redPotion: "hp+50"`、`bluePotion: "hp+200"` 及武器防具加成），有助于准确衡量支线收益。
  - `enemies`：本层每种怪的属性、当前伤害 `damage`、下一攻击临界 `critical: [需加攻击, 可减伤害]`，以及当前可直接接触到的坐标 `reachableNow`。
  - `objects` 与 `blockedObjects`：`objects` 包含当前开阔路径可直达的目标；`blockedObjects` 包含当前隔着墙壁、门或怪物的目标。网格中大写字母（`M/D/I/U/S/N/E`）和 `.` 表示瞬移可达，小写字母和 `,` 表示受阻。直接用结构化字段快速决策。
- **优先使用 `mota_move_to` 瞬移与寻路**：`mota_move_to` 调用游戏原生点击寻路，满足条件时自动瞬间移动（`mode: "teleport"`，返回 `savedSteps`），否则自动转为步行（`mode: "walk"`，返回 `teleportUnavailable` 原因）。可直接将目标坐标设为**道具、门、怪物或楼梯本身**——游戏会自动瞬移到其相邻格并迈出最后一步完成拾取、开门、战斗或上下楼。
- **瞬移条件**：当前楼层允许瞬移（`teleportAllowed: true`）、勇者未站在伤害格或非楼梯事件格上，且起点到目标相邻格之间存在仅由无事件空地组成的连通路径（不经过门、怪物、未拾取道具、NPC、伤害格 `!`）。
- **地形认知与绕行引导（避免徒劳碰壁）**：魔塔中绝大部分墙体不可通行。当 `mota_move_to` 提示受阻（`path_blocked` 或 `stopped_before_target`）时，通常是因为目标与你之间隔着墙壁或关着的门，直线单向硬走往往只是白耗步数。此时推荐先调用 `mota_screenshot` 观察全局地形或从 `mota_map` 寻找连通开阔路绕行；只有当你明确怀疑前方有暗道或隐藏路线时，才使用 `mota_move` 试探假墙。
- **探路优先与支线权衡（核心战术）**：
  1. **先拿免费资源**：进层先把 `freeReachable.item` 中无需开门打怪的钥匙、宝石、药水拿完。
  2. **0 伤怪只清挡路的**：只清理挡在必经通道或开阔资源前的 `damage: 0` 怪物以打通瞬移路径；死胡同里不挡路的 0 伤怪可以暂留（后期拿到“幸运金币”双倍金币宝物后再清收益翻倍）。
  3. **探路优先，上楼看风景**：查看 `upStairsRoute`——只要 `canPassNow: true` 且钥匙够开主路的门，**优先按 `firstStepTarget` 开主路直奔下一层探路**！高层往往摆着无需战斗或低代价的剑、盾、大血瓶和钥匙，拿到高层装备再回头打低层怪物战损会大幅降低。
  4. **权衡支线性价比**：前期宝石加成较小（如 `atk+1`），拿资源前留意怪物的防御临界。如果拿一颗宝石要付出的伤害远超它能帮你省下的血量，可以先跳过，走主路上楼。
- **跨层资源台账与楼层跳跃（全塔回溯）**：
  - 当当前楼层缺钥匙、无怪可打或主路不通时，不要局限于本层：调用 `mota_resources` 查看全塔所有已探索楼层中残留的钥匙、药水、宝石和怪物。
  - 如果拥有楼层跳跃器（背包有 `fly` 道具），可直接使用 `mota_fly`（例如 `mota_fly({ floorId: "MT5" })`）飞回低层收集漏捡的钥匙和补给，拿完后再飞回高层继续推进。
- **常规存档与顺序槽位**：
  - 魔塔拥有数百个存档位，`mota_saves` 会提示 `nextEmptySlot`，通常直接按自然序号递增保存（Slot 1, 2, 3...），无需纠结覆盖。
  - 推荐在两个关键节点养成存底档的好习惯：
    1. **初入新楼层**：每当迈入全新楼层，第一步先存一个底档作为该层探索基准；
    2. **关键决策前**：在做出不可逆重大资源消耗前存档（使用稀有红蓝钥匙开门前、商店加点前、挑战守关 Boss 或未知陷阱前）。
- **善用读档试错（优化与重来）**：
  - 魔塔本身就是充满试错与资源最优化的规划游戏，大胆多存档、随时读档重试不同策略！极限残血过关也是魔塔的正常玩法，不用因为血量低就慌张；当你觉得上一段战损偏高、钥匙使用不划算、想尝试更优路线时，随时可以自主读取之前的手动存档或 0 号自动存档重新推演。
  - **在以下死锁情况下更应果断读档**：
    1. **钥匙彻底断供**：主路缺钥匙且全塔已探楼层无任何可获取钥匙；
    2. **战力彻底锁死**：全塔已探楼层的所有可达怪均打不过（`damage: null`）且无可用金币或属性药水；
    3. **试探陷阱后撤退**：事先存好档以探明路线或陷阱为目的，摸清机制后回滚撤销。
  - 覆盖已有手动存档前必须取得用户明确批准；版本或安装安全校验不匹配时不要读取该存档。
- **阶段战况汇报（每 30 轮战况简报）**：
  - 当开启阶段战况汇报且收到行动满 30 轮的提示时，顺带使用 `pet_say` 气泡简明扼要地向主人汇报当前的楼层、血量、关键道具或探索进展（保持一两句轻松自然的陪伴语气，例如：“主人，我推进到第 7 层啦，刚拿了铁剑，血量还有 800 多，继续冲！”），汇报完后继续推塔。
- **遇阻求助，拒绝放弃（与主人商量）**：
  - 遇到推塔推不动、缺钥匙、怪打不过、读档重试多次无果，或面临重大抉择犹疑不定时，**不要自己硬撑或沉默放弃**！
  - 随时使用 `pet_say` 气泡主动向主人求助，汇报：① 当前所处楼层与卡点；② 你观察到的可能选项（如回哪一层找钥匙、加什么属性、或者读哪个档）；③ 询问主人的意见。求助后暂停自主动作，等待主人在聊天中给出指引。

等待类事件由游戏自身控制。

changelog.0.1.35: - Add classic Green Slime icon (assets/icon.png) for the World in Coopanion console and marketplace.
changelog.0.1.34:
- Rename the World to "h5魔塔（50层）" in the console (English: "H5 Magic Tower (50 floors)").
- Show the environment prompt tab in Chinese (title, description, variable notes) for Chinese consoles.
- Game connection panel: all buttons share one bordered box and are aligned in an even grid; the autonomous-play buttons use the same boxed style.
- Add a "high-consumption plugin" notice to the settings page and the READMEs.
- Rewrite both READMEs into a short, scannable guide.
changelog.0.1.33:
- Fix lock release bug where mota_fly did not clear actionInFlight, which caused all subsequent action tools to fail with action_in_progress.
- Unify action tool locking and unlocking logic using an ACTION_TOOLS set.
changelog.0.1.32:
- Update autonomous wake event prompt to guide Coo to ask her master for help via `pet_say` on roadblocks instead of stopping in silence.
- Generalize user references in prompts from specific nicknames to "主人" for multi-user distribution.
- Change autonomous wake interval range to 60–300 seconds, with default set to 60s.
- Add an enableable periodic progress report feature that reminds Coo to provide a brief status update via `pet_say` every 30 actions.
changelog.0.1.31:
- Eliminate rigid prohibitions in environment prompts; replace with game-mechanism explanations, heuristics, and an active "ask user for help" workflow via `pet_say` when stuck.
- Add `mota_resources` tool to query uncollected items, unopened doors, and remaining enemies across all visited floors, reporting both tower totals and per-floor coordinates.
- Add `mota_fly` tool to fast-travel to any previously visited floor when holding the floor jump item (`fly`).
changelog.0.1.30: - Encourage active reloading, trial-and-error, and tactical retry in environment prompts while strictly mandating reloads under 3 fatal scenarios (key softlock, stat softlock, and severe trial deficit / trap trigger).
changelog.0.1.29:
- Separate directly reachable `objects` from walled-off or obstructed `blockedObjects` in `floorView()` so Coo never targets inaccessible coordinates behind obstacles.
- Add `hint` to `mota_move_to` upon `path_blocked`, guiding Coo to visually inspect terrain with `mota_screenshot` instead of blindly bumping into walls with `mota_move`.
- Add `nextEmptySlot` to `mota_saves` to assist sequential save slot selection.
- Update environment prompts with user-aligned save rules (new-floor baseline save and pre-decision save into sequential slots) and strict reload rules (only on key softlocks, stat softlocks, or voluntary trap exploration rollbacks; no reloads on low HP or single obstacle blockage).
changelog.0.1.28:
- Remove `core.ui.closePanel()` from start and load flows so `mota_load` never crashes on the title screen and `mota_start_game` never aborts the opening `startText` / `changeFloor` sequence.
- Wait in `mota_start_game` until the initial floor (`core.status.thisMap`) or an interactive opening event is ready, and guard `floorView()` when `thisMap` is null.
changelog.0.1.27: - Fix TypeError 'Cannot set properties of undefined (setting data)' by guarding core.ui.closePanel() against undefined core.status.event on title screen, and deferred UI cleanup until after core.loadData completes.
changelog.0.1.26: - Fix loading saves while on the title screen by explicitly hiding #startPanel and UI overlays, ensuring the canvas map, status bar, and hero are displayed immediately.
changelog.0.1.25:
- Add precomputed `freeReachable`, minimum-damage `upStairsRoute` (with `canPassNow`, `totalDamage`, `doors`, `enemies`, and `firstStepTarget`), `itemValues`, and `reachableNow` enemy coordinates to floor views, and distinguish up-stairs (`U`) from down-stairs (`S`) in the grid.
- Guide Coo to prioritize scouting the next floor when `upStairsRoute` is passable, avoid net-negative gem branches, leave non-blocking 0-damage enemies for Lucky Coin scaling, and rely on precomputed route fields instead of manual grid counting.
changelog.0.1.24:
- Report teleport vs. walk mode, saved steps, and teleport blocker reasons in `mota_move_to` receipts, and document direct target teleport rules for items, doors, enemies, and stairs.
- Replace the verbose block array in `mota_map` with a character grid showing teleport reachability, grouped object coordinates, hazard tiles, and per-enemy damage and attack-critical summaries.
- Return compact delta receipts (`at`, `changes`, active `event`, and new `floor` view on floor changes) from action tools, and keep only non-zero held items in hero state.
- Condense autonomous wake notifications into a single-line summary marked `ephemeral` and tag `mota_status` and `mota_map` as `snapshot` tools.
- Expand the environment prompt with classic Magic Tower progression and backtracking strategies.
changelog.0.1.23:
- Read title-screen start availability and difficulty choices from the game.
- Start a new run through the native game start API after validating the selected difficulty.
changelog.0.1.22:
- Add target-tile movement through the game's native route and direct-move API.
- Make the autonomous wake interval configurable from 5 to 300 seconds, defaulting to 30.
- Localize the environment prompt to Chinese and add tower tips with autonomous save/load guidance; occupied-save overwrite still requires explicit approval.
changelog.0.1.21:
- Wake Coo on a 15-second schedule while an active game is connected.
- Prevent hidden canvas fallback text from overlapping the screenshot layers.
changelog.0.1.20: - Capture the full game area using each visible layer's displayed position and size.
changelog.0.1.19:
- List saves, save to a manual slot, and load manual or autosaves.
- Protect occupied slots and reject incompatible or unsafe saves.
changelog.0.1.18:
- Resume autonomous play after each completed game action.
- Detect screenshot support and explain when the game adapter must be updated.
- Treat pause messages according to the current autoplay setting.
changelog.0.1.17:
- Wake Coo on meaningful game-state changes when autonomous play is enabled.
- Add a pause control and a game-canvas screenshot tool for visual inspection.
changelog.0.1.16:
- Move up to 16 tiles in one direction and stop at the first event, obstruction, floor change, or game lock.
- Cancel the remaining movement steps when an active tool is interrupted.
changelog.0.1.15:
- Continue movement and dialogue actions across sequential model rounds in one user turn.
- Allow active actions to stop on interruption and return their completion state.
changelog.0.1.14: - Read visible game event text and choices, and add one-step dialogue and choice actions.
changelog.0.1.13: - Clarify adapter file destinations, show download guidance, and standardize download buttons.
changelog.0.1.12: - Add a guarded single-step movement tool with before and after position feedback.
changelog.0.1.11: - Separate token generation from downloads and offer the template and token-configured game adapter.
changelog.0.1.10: - Open the install directory through Windows Shell's `Invoke-Item` handler.
changelog.0.1.9: - Keep the Explorer launch that opens the folder and ignore only its nonzero exit status.
changelog.0.1.8: - Treat a successfully launched file manager as a successful folder-open action without waiting for its exit code.
changelog.0.1.7: - Open the plugin's install directory from the connection panel.
changelog.0.1.6: - Download a token-configured game adapter and open the selected game extensions folder from the connection panel.
changelog.0.1.5: - Add a random token generator and copy control to the connection panel.
changelog.0.1.4: - Add random token generation and copy controls to the World connection panel.
changelog.0.1.3: - Make the bridge token optional for activation and configure it in the World settings; authenticate the game adapter with the configured value.
changelog.0.1.2: - Remove the shared-token prerequisite from the read-only bridge; loopback binding and exact Origin validation remain.
changelog.0.1.1: - Resolve the WebSocket server from Cortico's runtime dependencies so local directory installs need no package-local `node_modules`.
changelog.0.1.0: - Add read-only status, floor map, and combat queries over a local WebSocket bridge.
